name: Biju Yuva Sashaktikaran Yojana
benefit: 1. An amount of ₹30,000/- per student is transferred directly to the bank accounts of 15,000 meritorious +2 students through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for the purchase of laptop.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident/domiciliary of the state of Odisha. 1. The application must be a +2 Passout from the Council of Higher Secondary Education, Odisha. 1. The students clearing the Upshastri Exam from Shree Jagannath Sanskrit University, Puri, are also eligible.
